properties.name: Fort Egbert National Historic Site
properties.fee_text: No fee for Fort Egbert. There is a $12 per night camping fee at the adjacent BLM Eagle Campground.

properties.name: Steese National Conservation Area
properties.fee_text: No fee for personal recreational use. Commercial guides are required to obtain a Special Recreation Permit from the BLM.

properties.name: Birch Creek Wild and Scenic River
properties.fee_text: No fee for personal recreation use. Commercial guides using the river need to obtain a Special Recreation Permit from the BLM.
properties.stay_limit: Camping at one site or campground within the Steese National Conservation Area for a period longer than 10 days in one calendar year is prohibited.

properties.name: Delta Wild and Scenic River
properties.fee_text: No fee for Delta Wild and Scenic River use. Camping at Tangle Lakes Campground is $15 per night drive in, and $6 per night walk in.

properties.name: Beaver Creek Wild and Scenic River
properties.fee_text: No fee for personal recreational use. Commercial boating guides are required to obtain a Special Recreation Permit from the BLM.

properties.name: Iditarod National Historic Trail Recreation Management Area
Fortymile Wild and Scenic River
properties.fee_text: No fee for personal recreational use. Commercial guides who wish to guide clients on the Fortymile Wild and Scenic River need to obtain a Special Recreation Permit from the BLM.

properties.name: Gulkana Wild and Scenic River
properties.fee_text: No fee for river use. Sourdough Creek and Paxson Lake Campgrounds charge $15 a night for overnight use.

properties.name: Brushkana Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: All sites are on a first come first served basis. Fee's per night=$20 for over night use Campground opening and closing dates are weather dependent and may vary from season to season. Generally Memorial Day through the first week of September (LaborDay) is typically when the site is accessible to the public.

properties.name: Marion Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: $12 per night. First come first serve only. Campground is open from mid-May through end of September (depending on snowfall).

properties.name: Arctic Circle Campground
properties.fee_text: $12 per night. First come first serve only. Campground is open from mid-May through end of September (depending on snowfall).

properties.name: Galbraith Lake Campground
properties.fee_text: $12 per night. First come first serve only. Campground is open from mid-May through end of September (depending on snowmelt and snowfall).

properties.name: Mount Prindle Campground
properties.fee_text: Fees- $12 per night per site (sites 1-13) on a first come basis.

properties.name: Ophir Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: Fees- $12 per night per site (sites 1-19) on a first come basis. $24 for group site 20 per night on a first come basis. (No discounts)

properties.name: Tangle Lakes Campground
properties.fee_text: FEE DESCRIPTION: $20 per site All sites are on a first come first serve basis. The Tangle Lakes Campground opening and closing dates are weather dependent and may vary from season to season. May 30th Memorial Day through the first week in September (Labor Day) is typically when the site is accessible and open to the public. No fee for Delta Wild and Scenic River use.

properties.name: Paxson Lake Campground
properties.fee_text: All sites are on a first come first serve basis. Fee's Per night = $20 for overnight use. The Paxson Lake Campground opening and closing dates are weather dependent and may vary from season to season. May 30th Mermorial Day through the first week in September (Labor Day) is typically when the site is accessible and open to the public.

properties.name: Sourdough Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: FEE DESCRIPTION: All campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis. No fee for river use. Sourdough Creek and Paxson Lake Campgrounds charge $20 a night for overnight use. Payment Methods Accepted – Cash (Kiosk) and Scan and Pay All Sites $20.00 per night

properties.name: Paxson Lake Campground
properties.stay_limit: 14 day stay limit per 60 day period

properties.name: White Mountains National Recreation Area - Alaska Cabins
Ophir Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: $12 per night for individual sites $24 per night for the group site All sites are available on a first come, first served basis

properties.name: Cripple Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: $12 per night for vehicle sites $6 per night for walk-in sites

properties.name: Crescent Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: Crescent Creek is not on the reservation system. There is a user-fee station at the campground.

properties.name: Eagles Nest Campground
properties.fee_text: $8/night peak season May 1 – September 30 $8/night non-peak season October 1 – April 30

properties.name: Harris River Campground
properties.fee_text: $8/night peak season May 1 – September 30 $8/night non-peak season October 1 – April 30

properties.name: Mendenhall Lake Campground
properties.fee_text: Full-service RV sites with electricity, water and sewer hook-ups ($36/night), partial-service RV sites with electricity and water hook-ups ($34/night), basic-service sites ($20/night)

properties.name: Ohmer Creek Campground
properties.fee_text: $0 No Fees Collected, campground is under minimal maintenance schedule due to budget constraints.
properties.season: No open/close season - available for day use and limited overnight use

properties.name: Starrigavan Rec Area - Campsites
properties.fee_text: Variable fees: May 1 through September 15 campsite fees $12-$16, September 15-April 30 campsite fees $12; group site fee $30 ; rental cabin $75 a night.
